fact: Civil servants who had not validated their biometric physical check in the SIGRH payroll and HR system had to produce papers including the carte Nina, under a grace period from 8 September 2025 extended to 30 January 2026 (L'Essor).
Mali launched on 10 February 2026 two online platforms, for the criminal record and the nationality certificate, where citizens apply using their NINA and civil-status details (Maliweb).
DPI Map records that NINA has no digital authentication function and no authentication through a government portal.
